name: MiseOS Vite Registry Console
description: Vite-powered read-only registry console for manifest browsing, risk summaries, publishing sequence visibility, and HMR-fast local development.

changePolicy.major: Human review required for dependency major upgrades, browser write capability, CSP policy changes, or external network expansion.
changePolicy.minor: Maintainer review required for dashboard features, new imports, or worker behavior.
changePolicy.patch: Automated validation allowed for docs, styles, and read-only rendering fixes.

release.cadence: manual until GHCR runner and primary packages are published
release.currentStrategy: Keep browser console read-only and validate with tsc plus Vite build in CI.
release.nextMilestone: Deploy static dashboard after registry publishing sequence stabilizes.

answers.what: A read-only Vite dashboard for the MiseOS Bootstrap Registry.
answers.does: Loads generated registry data, discovers manifests with import.meta.glob, runs risk scoring in a worker, and displays package lane analytics.
answers.permissions: Local read-only data access and local dev server network surface only.
answers.registry: Workspace package now; optional npm package @mise-os/registry-console later.
answers.changed: Added Vite app, config, TypeScript settings, generated registry data, worker analytics, docs, and CI workflow.
answers.safe: Safe by default because it is read-only and browser writes are review-gated.
answers.agentExecutable: Yes, agents may build or preview the console after running registry validation.
